description: This PHP source file defines a final class Create within the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace. The class provides static methods for creating and managing promise objects, including creating fulfilled promises, rejected promises, exception promises, and iterators from various input types.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create various kinds of promises and iterators in the GuzzleHttp promise system.

methods.name: promiseFor
methods.description: Creates a promise for a value if the value is not already a promise.

methods.name: rejectionFor
methods.description: Creates a rejected promise for a reason if the reason is not already a promise.

methods.name: exceptionFor
methods.description: Creates an exception for a rejected promise value.

methods.name: iterFor
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the given value, wrapping it in an iterator if necessary.
